messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Automotive?

The passages do not rank the capabilities, but the Automotive-relevant signaling test capabilities they support are mainly eCall / NG eCall, hybrid fallback, IMS voice/data, GNSS/MSD, network-scenario emulation, and 4G/5G/LTE/WLAN signaling coverage. [13][16][28][68]
- NG eCall testing over 4G/5G packet-switched / IMS networks, including EN 17240:2024 context, is a key Automotive signaling capability because emergency call systems must adapt from obsolete 2G/3G circuit-switched networks to 4G/5G packet-switched networks. [13][51]
- PSAP simulation and validation of NG eCall voice and data transmission are supported Automotive test capabilities in the cited R&S / Qualcomm verification context. [10][13]
- Hybrid eCall testing is important for validating reliable operation across NG eCall and classic CS eCall transport paths, including automatic fallback when coverage or service quality degrades. [28][30]
- Automotive eCall validation needs to verify call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning maintenance, and intelligible voice quality. [16][28]
- Relevant network scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation, and emulation of various network scenarios. [68]
- IMS / audio capabilities are relevant because CMX500 application and audio options cover IMS, 4G/5G IMS voice codecs, POLQA speech-quality measurement, WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA, and end-to-end audio delay. [4]
- General signaling capabilities include LTE, NR FR1/FR2, NSA/SA, FDD/TDD, WLAN signaling, TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application testing, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, and automation interfaces. [6]
- OTA signaling can also be relevant where automotive wireless devices require antenna or radiated testing, since MVG/CMX500 OBT sources list 5G NR, RedCap, LTE, and WLAN OTA signaling tests, including Wi‑Fi 7 / IEEE 802.11be. [35][75]

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

CMX500 Desense Testing
[[CMX500 Desense Testing]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中描述的 WLAN + cellular one-box interference / desense use case：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 在真實連線下同時處理 WLAN、LTE 與 NR 測試，觀察互相干擾或 desense 影響。

- CMW500 / CMW-KA096 來源中，CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available，需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。

- Valid SIM/USIM、forbidden PLMN、limited service condition、roaming scenario。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › RF ports 與 routing
- RF Com 1、RF Com 2：simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing；2 × SnapN；RF input/output to DUT。
- RF In 1、RF In 2：transmitter testing；2 × SnapN；RF input from DUT。
- RF Out 1 to RF Out 4：receiver testing；4 × SnapN；RF output to DUT。
- Receiver test functions：四個 RF generators（其中兩個在 GPRF mode）可 routing 到 RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4。
- Transmitter test functions：RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF In 1、RF In 2 ports 的四個 input signals 各可 split 到 one or two RF analyzers。
- FDA tables 支援 user-specific frequency-dependent attenuation corrections。

CMX configuration guide › NR-NTN
⚠️ 來源 CMX_Configuration_Guide_NR-NTN（converted 2026-09-10；正式文件日期來源未標示）說 [[R&S SMBVB-B103]] frequency range 為 9 kHz to 3.2 GHz，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMBV100B]] 說 formal specifications Version 13.01（August 2025）中 [[R&S SMBVB-B103]] 為 8 kHz to 3 GHz。判斷：以正式 SMBV100B specifications 作為產品規格；configuration guide 的 9 kHz to 3.2 GHz 暫列為未決矛盾，不用於規格引用。

詳細見 [[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]]。

CMX configuration guide › LTE-DTC
[[CMX_Configuration_Guide_LTE-DTC]] 專門整理 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[LTE-DTC]] / [[Direct-to-Cell]] 配置，包含 Golden Starlink LTE Direct-to-Cell xLAPI regression、LTE-DTC signaling lab、LTE-DTC + RF measurements 與 LTE-DTC + deeper protocol scope。

依該來源，Golden Starlink LTE-DTC xLAPI regression 的硬體為 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]]、2× [[R&S CMX-B200A]]、[[R&S CMX-B300C]]、[[R&S CMX-B600B]]；軟體為 [[R&S CMX-KS600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS550B]]、[[R&S CMX-KA100]]、[[R&S CMX-KF655X]]。

⚠️ 來源 CMX_Configuration_Guide_LTE-DTC（2026-09-10 converted；文件日期來源未標示）說 [[R&S CMX-B200A]] 在 LTE-DTC guide 中 Max 3× per CMX500，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500]] 說 CMX500 hardware unit 組合限制為 1 到 4 accelerator units。判斷：暫視為 LTE-DTC guide 的 application-specific rule 與 CMX500 general hardware capacity 的 scope 差異，不得把 LTE-DTC 的 Max 3× 當成 CMX500 全產品規格上限。

詳細見 [[CMX500 LTE-DTC configuration]]。

CMX configuration guide › NR-NTN
[[CMX_Configuration_Guide_NR-NTN]] 專門整理 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[NR-NTN]] 配置，包含 Golden S/L-band NR-NTN callbox、fading、user-defined CDL / TDL、mobility、Rel. 18 add-on、RF 3GPP preconformance、Ku-band n247、Ka-band n248、E2E application over NR-NTN、xLAPI protocol regression，以及 optional [[R&S SMBV100B]] NTN companion。

依該來源，Golden S/L-band NR-NTN callbox 的 scope 為 2 cells、Rel. 17、no fading、no mobility；硬體為 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]] + 1× [[R&S CMX-B200A]] + [[R&S CMX-B300C]] + [[R&S CMX-B600B]]；軟體為 [[R&S CMX-KS600B]] + [[R&S CMX-KS627B]] + [[R&S CMX-KA100]] + [[R&S CMX-KM600]] + [[R&S CMX-KM606]]。

NR-NTN source rules include：

- [[R&S CMX-B600B]] 是 S/L-band NTN standard RF path，sufficient for n250–n256。
- Standard S/L-band callbox 不需要 [[R&S CMX-B500A]]。
- Ku-band n247 需要 1× IF unit（[[R&S CMX-B500A]] 或 [[R&S CMX-B650]]），不需要 RRH。
- Ka-band n248 需要 2× IF unit（DL + UL）加 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50]] on UL path。
- [[R&S CMX-KS627B]] 是 NR-NTN Rel. 17 mandatory option，也是 [[R&S CMX-KM606]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KC665B]] 的 prerequisite。
- [[R&S CMX-KE611]] 用於 predefined NR NTN fading profiles，來源明示不需要 [[R&S CMX-KE601]] 或 [[R&S CMX-KS627M]]；custom CDL / TDL 另加 [[R&S CMX-KE620]]。
- Mobility / handover in scope 時需要 [[R&S CMX-KS600M]] + [[R&S CMX-KS627M]] tier match。
- NR NTN-specific ASN.1 editing in scope 時需要 [[R&S CMX-KS600X]] + relevant X tier + [[R&S CMX-KT600]]。
- [[R&S CMX-KF651X]] 是 Release 17 NR NTN xLAPI scenario package，用於 protocol regression automation，不是 standard callbox default KF。

⚠️ 來源 CMX_Configuration_Guide_NR-NTN（converted 2026-09-10；正式文件日期來源未標示）說 [[R&S CMX-B200A]] Max 3× per CMX500，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500]] 說 CMX500 hardware unit 組合限制為 1 到 4 accelerator units。判斷：暫視為 NR-NTN guide 的 application-specific rule 與 CMX500 general hardware capacity 的 scope 差異，不得把 NR-NTN 的 Max 3× 當成 CMX500 全產品規格上限。

CMX configuration guide › Power Consumption & Battery
Power Consumption & Battery 區段包含 CMX500 signaling 相關 [[R&S CMX-KM110]]、[[R&S CMX-KF680B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS500B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS600B]]，以及 NGM200 power supply 相關 [[R&S NGM201]] / [[R&S NGM202]]。來源明示 NGM200 is not a 1C product，configuration / prices 需聯絡 NGM product management。

CMX configuration guide
CMX configuration guide 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 內部 / 產品管理語境中用來列出 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]] 與相關附件 / software options 在特定 application 下所需配置的表格型資料；[[CMX_Configuration_Guide]]、[[CMX_Configuration_Guide_LTE-DTC]] 與 [[CMX_Configuration_Guide_NR-NTN]] 是目前支撐此概念的來源。

CMX_Configuration_Guide › 原文未解的問題
- 來源是 Excel 轉出的 lossy derivative；原始 `CMX_Configuration_Guide.xlsx` 才是 source of truth。
- 來源未標示 workbook version、document number 或 release owner，只在 guide list 中提供 `Last update` 2025-11-14。

The passages do not rank the capabilities, but the Automotive-relevant signaling test capabilities they support are mainly eCall / NG eCall, hybrid fallback, IMS voice/data, GNSS/MSD, network-scenario emulation, and 4G/5G/LTE/WLAN signaling coverage. [13][16][28][68]
- NG eCall testing over 4G/5G packet-switched / IMS networks, including EN 17240:2024 context, is a key Automotive signaling capability because emergency call systems must adapt from obsolete 2G/3G circuit-switched networks to 4G/5G packet-switched networks. [13][51]
- PSAP simulation and validation of NG eCall voice and data transmission are supported Automotive test capabilities in the cited R&S / Qualcomm verification context. [10][13]
- Hybrid eCall testing is important for validating reliable operation across NG eCall and classic CS eCall transport paths, including automatic fallback when coverage or service quality degrades. [28][30]
- Automotive eCall validation needs to verify call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning maintenance, and intelligible voice quality. [16][28]
- Relevant network scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation, and emulation of various network scenarios. [68]
- IMS / audio capabilities are relevant because CMX500 application and audio options cover IMS, 4G/5G IMS voice codecs, POLQA speech-quality measurement, WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA, and end-to-end audio delay. [4]
- General signaling capabilities include LTE, NR FR1/FR2, NSA/SA, FDD/TDD, WLAN signaling, TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application testing, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, and automation interfaces. [6]
- OTA signaling can also be relevant where automotive wireless devices require antenna or radiated testing, since MVG/CMX500 OBT sources list 5G NR, RedCap, LTE, and WLAN OTA signaling tests, including Wi‑Fi 7 / IEEE 802.11be. [35][75]

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing
[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 是驗證車輛 emergency call system 能在 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall transport paths 之間可靠運作與 fallback 的測試主題；[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 將其連到 [[EN 18052]]:2025、[[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA09x]]。

MVG CMX500 OBT OTA signaling testing
[[MVG CMX500 OBT OTA signaling testing]] 是 [[MVG]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 新聞稿中描述的整合測試情境：將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[MVG]] 的 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]，讓 [[MVG]] antenna / multiprobe measurement systems 可直接執行 [[5G NR]]、[[RedCap]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[WLAN]] OTA signaling tests。[[MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz]] 將此情境擴充到 full [[WLAN]] signaling test functionality including [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › Regulatory transition context
同一來源提供下列背景，但未列 regulation 文件編號：

- [[eCall]] automated vehicle emergency call system introduced in 2015。
- eCall 自 2018 年起是 all new cars sold within the European Union 的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源稱 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks become obsolete，因此 emergency call systems 需要 adapted to 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] most recent regulation 定義 NG eCall will be obligatory starting **2026-01-01**。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 establishes guidelines for testing eCall systems over [[IMS]] networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試情境
來源明示或列出的 network scenarios 包含：

- [[VoNR]]。
- [[VoLTE]]。
- circuit-switched fallback。
- handovers。
- degraded radio conditions。
- real-world mobile network conditions simulation。
- various network scenarios emulation。

來源沒有提供各 scenario 的 test case IDs、channel model、radio profile 或 pass/fail criteria。

MVG CMX500 OBT OTA signaling testing › 來源列出的測試能力
目前兩份 MVG / R&S PR 明確列出的能力包含：

- [[5G NR]] OTA signaling testing。
- [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）mode。
- [[5G NR FR1]] SA。
- [[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（[[EN-DC]]）。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[LTE]] OTA signaling testing。
- [[LTE]] FDD & TDD signaling testing。
- Full Wi‑Fi / [[WLAN]] access point and station testing functionality。
- [[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]。
- multiple hardware configurations of [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]，包括 `CMX Lite` 與 `CMX Pro`（僅前一份來源列名，未定義正式 BOM）。
